description:
Advances: ancora.gate.only_git_is_spawned

Scope expansion carved from the semantic conflict found when rebasing ancora-yzu.7 (L6) onto the epic branch.

Problem: lib/ancora/trailer.ex (landed in L2, before the Git layer existed) calls System.cmd directly at Trailer.read/2 to run 'git log <base>..HEAD --format=%B'. L6 adds the standing static guard the spec mandates (ancora.gate.only_git_is_spawned: no spawn outside lib/ancora/git.ex and lib/ancora/git/), and the combined tree fails Ancora.Static.ForbiddenSpawnerTest. Neither branch is wrong alone; the adapter belongs to neither ticket's scope.

Deliverable: Trailer.read/2 delegates its subprocess call to Ancora.Git.run/3 (same args: -C semantics preserved via Git.run's root parameter; format=%B). Behavior preserved: non-zero git exit still returns %{overrides: %{}, warnings: []}. No other call sites change.

IMPORTANT — stage base: this ticket's stage branch is cut from the REBASED ancora-yzu.7 tip (17fd520), not the epic tip, because Ancora.Git only exists there. Closing this ticket merges the L6 stack (17fd520 + this fix) together under one gate.

Verification:
- Tests to pass: test/ancora/static/forbidden_spawner_test.exs (goes green on the combined tree — this is the point), test/ancora/trailer_test.exs unchanged and green (including the non-zero-exit path)
- Iteration tier: mix test test/ancora/trailer_test.exs test/ancora/static/forbidden_spawner_test.exs
- Final tier: change-scoped — those files plus mix test --stale; full suite at the merge gate
- Verifier tier: confirm Trailer.read's spawn is gone (the static test is the mechanical proof), trailer behavior unchanged, no new seams
- Standing bounce-class checks: Would-fail-if claims must name production failures (see epic LESSONS)

Allowed touches (this stage may modify):
- lib/ancora/trailer.ex
- test/ancora/trailer_test.exs (only if an assertion must follow the call-path change; behavior assertions stay)
- .spec/specs/ancora.gate.spec.md (only if the gate demands a subject co-change; none is expected)

Out of Scope (files):
- lib/ancora/git.ex, lib/ancora/git/** (use the existing Git.run/3 surface as-is)
- NOTICE, .gitattributes, mix.exs, mix.lock
- everything else

Out of Scope (intent):
- no Git.run signature changes, no new options, no refactor of trailer parsing

Merge gate:
- [ ] Scope check: diff touches only Allowed files
- [ ] Epic worktree smoke green after ff-merge of the stack (144 tests)
